entities.name: John
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A married father of at least three children, including a son Kyle who was one year old in March 2023 and a daughter Sara. He grew up in West County and lives in the same community as Maria. He worked at a mechanical engineering company, was promoted to assistant manager shortly before 16 June 2023 and lost the job in early August 2023 when the company went under. He has wanted to get into local politics since at least December 2022, focusing on education and infrastructure, graduated with a university degree in late March 2023, failed a military aptitude test in late 2022 and retook it with good results in early March 2023, and joined a volunteer fire-fighting brigade in July 2023.

entities.name: Maria
entities.description: One of the two speakers and John's close friend. She has volunteered at a homeless shelter since about August 2022, when she saw a family struggling on the streets, and from June 2023 also at a local dog shelter once a month. Her family is small: a mother, an aunt whose example started her volunteering, a cousin she helped rehouse, and a grandmother who died in early March 2023. She practises aerial yoga, joined a gym in June 2023 and a church in May 2023, took creative writing and poetry classes, travelled alone to Spain in 2022, and acquired two dogs, Coco and Shadow, in the summer of 2023.

entities.name: Kyle
entities.description: John's son, one year old when John named him on 6 March 2023.

entities.name: John's wife
entities.description: John's wife, never named and referred to as the wife and the missus. She is part of the family John describes as his rock and his motivation.

entities.name: Rob
entities.description: A colleague of John's who invited him to a beginner's yoga class in February 2023; John started a weekend yoga class with a colleague in April 2023.

entities.name: Jean
entities.description: A woman Maria met while volunteering at the homeless shelter on 24 February 2023. She had been through a divorce, lost her job and become homeless, and Maria found her optimism and gratitude striking.

entities.name: David
entities.description: A man Maria met at the charity event on 3 February 2023. She heard his story of hardship and afterwards connected him with a nearby organisation offering housing and support for homeless people.

entities.name: Maria's aunt
entities.description: Maria's aunt, referred to as my aunt and as our auntie. She believed in volunteering and helped Maria's family through their money problems when Maria was younger, which is the reason Maria started volunteering.

entities.name: Maria's grandmother
entities.description: Maria's grandmother, who died in the week before 6 March 2023; Maria was finding the loss hard.

entities.name: London
entities.description: The city in England Maria visited a few years before March 2023. Its architecture and castles inspired the castle shadow box and the castle painting she made for her home.

entities.name: England
entities.description: The country Maria travelled to a few years before March 2023; the trip was to London and she came back mesmerised by the castles.

entities.name: the homeless shelter
entities.description: The homeless shelter Maria has volunteered at since about August 2022, referred to throughout simply as the shelter. She donated her old car to it in December 2022, helped at an event for children, gave talks there, organised a meal for residents, ran a 5K charity run and a chili cook-off fundraiser for it, received letters of thanks from residents Laura and Cindy, and was given a medal by it in August 2023. John's online service group also gave out food and supplies at a homeless shelter.

entities.name: the service-focused online group
entities.description: The online group John joined in the last week of December 2022, made up of people who share a passion for serving. Its members met in person, gave out food and supplies at a homeless shelter and ran a toy drive, and were brainstorming projects on education, mentorship, job training and resume building. By August 2023 John was asking family and friends to join it and advocate for the military. Referred to as the service-focused online group and as the virtual support group.

entities.name: the creative writing class
entities.description: A creative writing class Maria took shortly before 25 February 2023 and described as super enlightening.

entities.name: aerial yoga
entities.description: Maria's aerial yoga practice, started shortly before 17 December 2022. She uses it to switch off and focus on her body, and her favourites are the upside-down poses.

entities.name: yoga
entities.description: John's yoga practice. His colleague Rob invited him to a beginner's class in February 2023 and he started a weekend beginner class in April 2023, focused on poses and breathing; by 7 April 2023 it was part of his daily routine, and he continued at his yoga studio.

entities.name: kickboxing
entities.description: The kickboxing John was doing as of 17 December 2022, which he said was giving him energy. It is also one of the classes his yoga studio offers.

entities.name: John's run for local office
entities.description: John's political ambition and campaigning. Joins the mentions of getting into local politics from December 2022, the campaign Maria asks after, networking with community leaders and organisations, the community meetings, the policy blog, going into policymaking after his degree, and the decision in early May 2023 to run for office again despite earlier unsuccessful runs. Its subjects throughout are education and infrastructure.

entities.name: the community food drive
entities.description: The community food drive John was helping with by 5 February 2023 for people who had lost their jobs, which he started because of unemployment in the community. The response and the number of volunteers overwhelmed him, and Maria offered to help with networking and at future events.

entities.name: John's car
entities.description: John's car. Its windshield was broken in an unexpected incident on his way home in the week before 9 January 2023, and it broke down on his way to work on Friday 7 April 2023, with the repairs straining his finances.

entities.name: Maria's mother
entities.description: Maria's mother, part of the small family Maria relies on for strength. They cooked dinner together on 3 May 2023.

entities.name: West County
entities.description: The area John grew up in, referred to as West County, as his old area and as back home. He renovated a rundown community centre there in 2022, said on 6 May 2023 that he wanted to work on improving it, and it was hit by a bad flood in the week before 7 July 2023 that ruined many homes because the infrastructure was poor.

entities.name: Spain
entities.description: Where Maria took a solo trip in 2022 during a hard period of her life. She photographed a beach and a small island there, surfed for the first time, and came back valuing solitude, inner strength and different perspectives.

entities.name: the Pacific Northwest
entities.description: The stretch of coast and the national parks John's family explored on a road trip in 2022, which he remembers for the beauty of the nature.

entities.name: Maria's church
entities.description: The nearby church Maria joined on 5 May 2023 to feel closer to a community and to her faith. Through mid-2023 she went camping, picnicking and hiking with friends from it and took up community work with them.

entities.name: the local school
entities.description: A local school John is involved with. This joins two mentions of a local school that are consistent in every detail given: the career fair he volunteered at over the weekend of 1-2 April 2023, where he saw how a lack of resources affects children's dreams, and the school where he was volunteering as a mentor by 13 August 2023, whose students had improved in confidence and skills.

entities.name: the poetry class
entities.description: A poetry class Maria was taking as of 2 April 2023 to help her put her feelings into words; she described it as a rough ride but good.

entities.name: family boot camp
entities.description: The boot camp workouts John started doing with his family in April 2023, three times a week, for bonding and fitness. They gained energy, strength and endurance, and his children became excited about staying active.

entities.name: John's project to support military veterans
entities.description: The project John was busy with by 20 May 2023 to support military veterans and their rights, run partly through a petition. It takes in the party for veterans on 19 May 2023, the marching event for veterans rights in mid-2023, the visit to a veterans hospital in July 2023, the advocacy he asked his online group to join, and the 5K charity run for veterans and their families over 5-6 August 2023.

entities.name: John's community infrastructure project
entities.description: The community project on infrastructure John said on 6 May 2023 he was thinking of starting, after a power cut and over the state of the potholed roads, and which Maria agreed to help him get the neighbourhood behind. Joined with the meeting he was gathering people for on 7 July 2023 to discuss solutions after the flood, which Maria also agreed to join.

entities.name: the homeless shelter fundraiser
entities.description: The homeless shelter's fundraiser at the end of May 2023, intended to raise enough to cover basic needs for homeless people. Maria planned a ring-toss tournament and a chili cook-off for it and asked John to spread the word and find volunteers.

entities.name: Sara
entities.description: John's daughter. The family took a trip in 2022 for her birthday, and the photograph from it is one John says reminds him why he keeps going.

entities.name: Laura
entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter who wrote Maria and the other volunteers a letter expressing her gratitude, which Maria described on 3 July 2023.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: An elderly veteran John met at the veterans hospital he visited in the week before 17 July 2023. His stories were inspiring and heartbreaking, and hearing them reminded John why he had wanted to join the military.

entities.name: Maria's cousin
entities.description: Maria's cousin, who had to leave her home in a hurry and find a new place in mid-2023. Maria was helping her look, and John offered to find organisations and resources that could help.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: John's family dog for ten years, who died shortly before 3 June 2023. John says Max taught the family unconditional love and loyalty, remembers a camping trip with him in summer 2022 as his best memory, and was still thinking about him in August 2023.

entities.name: Oregon
entities.description: Where Maria's family took a road trip when she was younger; she remembers hiking to the top and a waterfall with a bridge over it as the prettiest spot.

entities.name: California
entities.description: Where John's family had a vacation he remembers for a gorgeous sunset and an evening walk along the shore.

entities.name: Florida
entities.description: Where Maria had a family vacation she remembers for the colours of the sunset and a feeling of gratitude sitting there with her family.

entities.name: the local dog shelter
entities.description: The local dog shelter Maria started volunteering at once a month as of 3 June 2023, and the kind of place she adopted Shadow from in August 2023. She offered to help John's family when they were considering adopting a rescue dog.

entities.name: Maria's gym
entities.description: The gym Maria joined in the week before 16 June 2023. She found the people and the atmosphere welcoming, works on strength and endurance there, was trying kundalini yoga, and has friends from it she goes to dinner with.

entities.name: the mechanical engineering company
entities.description: John's employer, a mechanical engineering company. He was promoted to assistant manager there shortly before 16 June 2023, said on 22 July 2023 that he was enjoying the new job and his team, and lost the job in early August 2023 when the company went under.

entities.name: camping
entities.description: Camping. John has been plenty of times and likes how uncomplicated it is, including a trip with his dog Max in summer 2022; Maria has been a few times, including with friends from her church over the weekend of 10-11 June 2023, and has never tried mountain climbing.

entities.name: Cindy
entities.description: A resident of the homeless shelter who wrote Maria a heartfelt note of gratitude, which Maria described on 3 August 2023.

entities.name: Coco
entities.description: Maria's puppy, acquired about two weeks before 11 August 2023. Maria's first pet, she greets Maria when she comes home and has been an adjustment to care for; she gets along with Shadow.

entities.name: Shadow
entities.description: Maria's second puppy, adopted from a shelter in the week before 13 August 2023. She is full of energy, was learning commands and house training, and gets along with Coco.

entities.name: John's yoga studio
entities.description: The yoga studio John goes to often, described on 22 July 2023 as having a chill vibe and great instructors. It offers yoga, kickboxing and circuit training, and John has also done weight training there.

entities.name: the fire-fighting brigade
entities.description: The volunteer fire-fighting brigade John joined in July 2023, after Maria's shelter work made him think about how he could give back. The training was intense, the first call-out on Sunday 30 July 2023 saved a family from a burning building, and a two-hour donation drive in August 2023 collected canned food, toiletries and clothes and helped pay for a new fire truck. John calls the team a family and the work his true calling.
